description: Submit a human rater's score for a criterion that is waiting on a human. Score is a number on the criterion scale or an ordinal/binary label. Find what is waiting with `list_human_tasks`. Returns the evaluation's summary; once the last pending criterion is scored, the total, grade and pass/fail are filled in.

criterionId.description: Id of the criterion being scored, as the pending task names it.

evaluationId.description: The evaluation the task belongs to: `evaluationId` from `list_human_tasks`, or `id` from `evaluate`.

raterId.description: Who is scoring. When the task names its raters, this must be one of them.

rationale.description: Why this score, in the rater's words. Stored with the score.

score.description: A number on the criterion's scale, a label of an ordinal or binary scale, or, for a choice criterion, one of its option ids.

name: submit_human_score
title: Submit human score
